summary:
Prepared SPARQL Update (prepareUpdate) is implemented but unverified: I did not run tests, black, or any repository code, per the instructions.

Changes:
- rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py: new Update(prologue, algebra) container beside Query.
- rdflib/plugins/sparql/algebra.py: translateUpdate always returns an Update. The empty-request path builds the prologue from q.prologue[0] with base and initNs and returns an empty algebra list. Added the Update import to the existing sparql import line.
- rdflib/plugins/sparql/update.py: evalUpdate iterates update.algebra; per-operation behavior unchanged.
- rdflib/plugins/sparql/processor.py: added prepareUpdate after prepareQuery, recording _original_args. SPARQLUpdateProcessor.update and processUpdate are unchanged.
- rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py: exports prepareUpdate.
- test/test_sparql_prepare.py (new): covers prepare-then-Graph.update, reuse across graphs and repeated application, initNs prefixes, initial bindings, direct evaluation, container shape, empty request, declarations-only prologue, no-mutation check, and empty strings via processUpdate and Graph.update.

Open points: the initial-bindings test (INSERT { ?s ex:p ?o } WHERE { }) assumes the empty WHERE yields one solution carrying the bindings; not confirmed by running. Nothing was committed.
